BEFORE YOUR FIRST DANCE

A few little
good-to-knows.

I'm new to line dancing. Where do I start?

You're welcome to get in touch. Let Michelle know that you're a beginner and where you're based, and she'll help you explore a suitable class.

Where and when are the classes?

Line & Wine has branches across Cape Town and KwaZulu-Natal. Message Michelle for the latest venues, schedules, and availability in your area.

What should I wear or bring?

Comfortable clothing you can move in is a good place to start. Check with Michelle about footwear and anything else needed for your chosen venue.

Can I enquire about a new branch?

Absolutely. We're open to opportunities for further expansion. Send Michelle an email with your location and ideas.
